cuda_details.interpretation: Intervals are clipped to the selected window; copy bytes count each intersecting operation in full. Synchronization is host API time and its temporal overlap with this process's GPU work, not avoidable waiting or causal attribution. Stream and copy unions must not be added to obtain a task critical path. Graph intervals contain unobserved internals, so compute overlap is an upper bound with graph-level tracing. Runtime correlation uses process plus correlation ID; grouped GPU operations count once per API invocation. Negative API-return-to-GPU delay means GPU execution started before the host API returned. This delay is not vLLM request queue time.

native_steady_windows.interpretation: All operations are clipped to the declared steady window. Stage and kernel sums are cumulative resource time and cannot be added into a task critical path. Forward launch patterns use complete native forward spans and API records fully contained on the same host thread. CUDA runtime and driver records can nest, so launch counts are API records, not unique GPU kernel executions. They identify observed launch paths, not prompt/decode batch sizes or hardware bandwidth. A graph launch may be a complete or piecewise graph. Profiling measurements remain separate from unprofiled performance.

next_experiment_decision.scope: A targeted native-graph coverage screen, not final configuration adoption. Raw stage material must be retrieved and verified before its GPU work starts.
next_experiment_decision.finding: In matched 15-second native windows, C64 has 1053 complete forward spans, with 27.3504% no-Graph paths; C96 has 615 spans, with 57.5610% no-Graph paths. Mean host duration of those paths is 28.5510 versus 28.3295 ms. GPU activity interval union is 7.21385 versus 4.96461 seconds. Prefix behavior and model requests remain real.
next_experiment_decision.source_evidence: Active S64 service captures through 128 tokens. Native dispatcher returns NONE above its maximum captured size. FULL_AND_PIECEWISE is active, and the GDN backend supports UNIFORM_BATCH, not arbitrary full mixed batches.
next_experiment_decision.inference_limit: These traces identify launch paths but do not record each scheduler batch token count. The graph-size guard is a plausible cause to test, not an already proven explanation of every no-Graph span. Runtime/driver API records can nest; API counts are not unique kernel executions.
next_experiment_decision.experiment: Compare native default G128 with G1024 and G4096, keeping the existing decode sizes, S64/B8192/API1/P32, APC align, model, budgets and real tools. Measure C64 and C96 with paired controls. No Nsight, NVTX or trajectory export in these six runs.
next_experiment_decision.quality: The original strict per-task gates are unchanged. The C64 plain profiling control had an extra safety error round; do not label it qualified or count any profiling case as an independent formal repeat.
